responsibility: Declares the gimple_range_op_handler wrapper that maps supported GIMPLE statements onto generic range_op handlers. The interface exposes operand extraction, support tests, and inverse range-solving helpers for operands, as well as the utility that collects relevant SSA-name operands from a statement for ranger and GORI analyses.
same_name_distinction: Declares the gimple_range_op_handler interface and the gimple_range_ssa_names helper that gcc/gimple-range-op.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file, it defines the adapter API used by ranger/GORI clients, not the built-in dispatch tables and operand-solving implementation.
